--- before-OP26-repair/tests/test-sdd-analyze.sh
+++ current/tests/test-sdd-analyze.sh
@@ -688,6 +688,34 @@
     done
   done
 
+  # O-034: executable directories cannot turn known weak tools into tests.
+  local weak_qualified_cases=() runner_qualified_cases=()
+  for prefix in '' ./tests/ tests/ test/ tools/tests/ ./tests/node_modules/.bin/ tools/; do
+    for fixture in 'tsc --noEmit tests/unit.ts' 'npm run build' 'npm run typecheck' \
+      'pnpm run build' 'yarn typecheck' 'bun build' 'go build' 'make build' \
+      'cargo build' 'test -e README.md' 'test -f README.md'; do
+      weak_qualified_cases+=("$prefix$fixture")
+    done
+    for fixture in 'npm test -- --grep typecheck' 'npm run test -- --grep typecheck' \
+      'pnpm test tests/build.js' 'yarn run test tests/typecheck.js' \
+      'bun test tests/typecheck.ts' 'go test ./build' 'make test TARGET=typecheck' \
+      'cargo test --test build'; do
+      runner_qualified_cases+=("$prefix$fixture")
+    done
+  done
+  for redirect in '<input.txt' '>out.txt' '>>out.txt' '>|out.txt' '<>input.txt' '<&0' '>&1' '&>out.txt'; do
+    for fixture in './tests/npmREDIRECT run typecheck' \
+      './tests/node_modules/.bin/tscREDIRECT --noEmit tests/unit.ts' \
+      'test/testREDIRECT -f README.md' 'tools/tests/cargoREDIRECT build'; do
+      weak_qualified_cases+=("${fixture%%REDIRECT*}$redirect${fixture#*REDIRECT}")
+    done
+    for fixture in './tests/npmREDIRECT run test -- --grep typecheck' \
+      './tests/cargoREDIRECT test --test build' './tests/bunREDIRECT test tests/typecheck.ts' \
+      './tests/goREDIRECT test ./build'; do
+      runner_qualified_cases+=("${fixture%%REDIRECT*}$redirect${fixture#*REDIRECT}")
+    done
+  done
+
   # AC-004/O-034: arguments and redirection targets do not become runners.
   for fixture in \
     'npm run build' 'npm run typecheck' 'tsc --noEmit' 'grep AC-001 README.md' \
@@ -746,7 +774,7 @@
     'tsc 2>output.txt --noEmit' 'npm2>output.txt test typecheck.txt' \
     'npm&>tests/typecheck.log run build' 'tsc>&tests/check.log --noEmit' \
     'npm 2&>out.txt test typecheck.txt' \
-    "${weak_redirect_cases[@]}"; do
